description: This file defines an abstract Java class named CatalogEntity used as a base for catalog-related entities in the application. It extends ShopEntity and implements Serializable, containing properties like name, description, friendlyUrl, keyWords, highlights, metaDescription, and title, along with their respective getters and setters.

classes.name: CatalogEntity
classes.description: An abstract class representing catalog entities, providing common properties such as name, description, URLs, keywords, and meta information.
